release_notes: Huge update: new horizontal Nebula top nav bar across all screens, Nebula is now the default theme, a completely rebuilt 14-sport Sports Bar (football, NFL, UFC, boxing, F1, rugby, cricket, darts, snooker, tennis, golf, basketball, hockey, baseball, AFL) with live channel matching, D-pad scrolling fix, EPG auto-refresh with a progress indicator and a safer low-memory guide loader, and safer update downloads (checksum-verified).
